notes.title: Demo Update 1
notes.content: [h3]Additions:[/h3][list][*][p]Time and score icons instead of raw text[/p][/*][*][p]Range indicator and crosshair while holding a cast button[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Selling at a shop sells the item and removes the effect[/p][/*][*][p]Real-time trinkets (e.g. Sage Pendulum) no longer continuously reset certain variables, so casting will slow the player as intended[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Eversear will appear where you cast it[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Spells are cast on mouse button release due to range indicator addition[/p][/*][*][p]Eversear: +range[/p][/*][*][p]Flame Claw: -range[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugs I'm Aware of but Don't Know How To Fix Right Now:[/h3][list][*][p]Shops stop appearing in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]Crash during death in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]Element selection prompt after death in some cases[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Time and score icons instead of raw text
Range indicator and crosshair while holding a cast button

tags.bug: Selling at a shop sells the item and removes the effect
Real-time trinkets (e.g. Sage Pendulum) no longer continuously reset certain variables, so casting will slow the player as intended
Eversear will appear where you cast it
